comment.narrative: CRGE Facility Management Committee NDC of Ethiopia REDD+ MRV NDC Partnerships

1. Awareness of stakeholders Enhanced on NDC/NAP and Green Technology development. 2. Designing of NDC Implementation Plan 3. Identifying roles and responsibilities of Actors 4. Conduct diagnostic study on how to incentivize private sector involvement in NDC. 5. Print and Dissemination of strategies and other documents prepared under DEEPDIVE and Climate Promise Projects. 6. Designing of Private Sector Engagement Strategy

1- Capacities of sectors at the federal and regional level built by organizing different trainings (3 Trainings) that will help them in the implementation of updated NDC and in the development & dissemination of Green Technologies. 2. After conducting a series of four multi-stakeholder planning workshops in 2022, NDC Implementation plan of sectors were prepared, endorsed by respective pillar NDC sectors and validated. The plan will soon be uploaded on the web site of the NDC Partnership Support Unit to mobilize technical and financial support. Bankable proposals will also be designed in 2023 for the priority selected action of the NDC Implementation Plan. 3. Key to successful NDC implementation is good governance and coordination among sectors, different stakeholders and government and civil society to effectively contribute to achievement of the updated NDC plan aligned with the 10 Year Development Plan. Gaps were observed on the governance and coordination of CRGE/NDC. The objectives of this study are reviewing the existing governance land scape and current institutional arrangements against the needs for implementing the revised NDC and give recommendation for the establishment and operationalization of the revised multilevel institutional governance and coordination structures. In this regard, in 2022 Report on the identification of roles and responsibilities of actors on the implementation of NDC is prepared and the report is validated. 4. Final Report of the task “Conduct diagnostic study on how to incentivize private sector involvement in NDC implementation” is prepared and validated in 2022. The report identifies. ? The barriers or factors that discourage the private sector investment across relevant priority actions for NDC implementation in Ethiopia. ? The range of financial and non-financial interventions/Incentive Mechanisms needed to address barriers for private sector investment across relevant priority actions for NDC implementation. 5. 2250 copies of the following documents: NDC Update Technical Report, NDC Update Summary Report, Gender Analysis for Updated NDC, Finance Strategy of updated NDC, Report on Updating the Scope of Health and Urban Sector on NDC, Capacity Gap Assessment of Agriculture and Forest Sectors, Capacity Gap Assessment of Industry, Energy & Transport Sectors and Capacity Gap Assessment of Urban & Mining Sectors are printed and disseminated. 6. Based on the diagnostic study on private sector engagement in the implementation of NDC, Inception Report to design private sector engagement is developed in 2022 and the strategy is finalized in the first quarter of 2023.

1.8 NDC sectors Capacity assessed; gaps identified and action plans prepared to fill the gaps 2.200 Stakeholders whose awareness raised on NDC/NAP 3.Finance strategy for the implementations of updated NDC validated 4.Support provided for the updated NDC of Ethiopia
1.Coordination Platform for NDC sectors with clear roles and responsibilities established 2.Updated NDC by 2020 3.Partnership Plan developed for the implementation of updated Ethiopias NDC.
